2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function, pte_none_or_zero(), to the Linux kernel's mm module. The function takes a page table entry (pte) as input and returns true if it represents either an empty mapping or a mapping of the shared zero-page. This allows code that only cares about the contents of a PTE to treat these two cases alike, simplifying its logic. The patch also moves a local helper for this test from khugepaged.c to pgtable.h and converts open-coded instances in migrate_device.c to use the new function. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
